summaryZh: Siegel Laboratory 以有机合成为核心，研究来自天然产物、信号脂质和疾病先导物的小分子。实验室合成复杂化合物并开发化学探针，以研究小分子控制的通路和支持药物开发。
topics: 天然产物与药物先导物

evidence.quote: Research in The Siegel Laboratory is centered on organic synthesis.
small molecules our group works on originate from natural sources, natural products, signaling lipids, as well as small molecule leads for diseases
Chemical probes to decipher pathways controlled by small molecules are also developed and tested within the group
Our research group is housed in the Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences Building at UCSD .
